The House Bill 1063 By: Representatives Thomas of Special Committee on Resource Management offers the 21st, Burns of the 159th, Cannon of the 172nd, Donatucci of the 105th, Hilton of the 48th, and others following substitute to HB 1063:
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 1 of Chapter 3 of Title 46 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to generation and distribution of electricity generally, so as to require electric utilities … enterprise to operate, manage, or maintain a computer, group of computers, or other organized assembly of hardware and software for the primary purpose of processing, storing, retrieving, or transmitting data and that have a peak annual electricity demand of 100 megawatt hours megawatts or greater.
46-3-81. Each contract between an electric utility and a data center for the provision of electric service shall include terms and conditions designed to protect residential and retail electricity customers from costs associated with data center construction … 46-3-83. Pursuant to the commission's jurisdictional authority under Code Section 46-2-20, the commission shall make determinations related to compliance with this Code section."
SECTION 2. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
